description: This file defines a class MonitorFilesystem that extends BokehTemplate to create an interactive filesystem monitoring dashboard. It loads and updates JSON-based statistics and file type data, and configures Bokeh plots for visualizing filesystem usage over time.

classes.name: MonitorFilesystem
classes.description: A class for monitoring filesystem statistics and visualizing them using Bokeh plots.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting up configuration, allowed types, and loading existing data.

methods.name: initial_load
methods.description: Loads existing filesystem statistics and file type data from JSON files.

methods.name: update_plots
methods.description: Updates Bokeh data sources with current or new filesystem data for visualization.

methods.name: read_new_data
methods.description: Reads new data from JSON files if they have been modified since the last update, and appends it to existing tables.
